head: kae
rule: แก้ is one verb of UNDOING that the RID has split eight ways, and the branch structure does the sorting: 2 is the literal untying of what is tight, knotted or stuck; 3 generalises it to getting free of a thing; 4 turns it into repair; 5 narrows repair to making an affliction go away; 6 turns it into answering and explaining; 8 turns it into getting something back. Sort by what the RID's own gloss says is being undone, in this order: reciprocation first — ทำตอบ, ตอบโต้, หักล้าง, ขอสู้ใหม่, countering a move or a stratagem — files under 8, because paying it back is getting it back; then พ้น and ปลดเปลื้อง, being freed of a shame, a vow, a sin or a fault, files under 3; then บรรเทา and ปัดเป่า, an embarrassment or an omen dispelled, files under 5; ติดขัด and anything physically wrapped or fastened stays at 2; a defective document made correct is 4; and answering, solving or interpreting is 6. Sense 1 is the cowrie shell, an unrelated homonym, and takes nothing; sense 7 is antiphonal singing and its compounds are head-final (เพลงแก้), so none appear here.
